params.chi_definition: chi = Mdot_seis / Mdot_geo with Mdot_geo = 2*mu*H*A*max_shear (EXP-J definition kept so chi is comparable); the fault-RESOLVED shear is reported per cell and used for stratification/reporting, not substituted into chi

k2_fault_geometry.geometry_file_format: GMT multi-segment; segment headers are '> strike dip rake' (3 numeric fields, all 557 headers parsed), followed by 'lon lat elevation_m' point lines
k2_fault_geometry.traces_file_format: same GMT multi-segment traces with '> "fault_name"' headers; point lines identical to the geometry file

k4_strata.definition: style (3) x on/off-fault (2); primary ledger = variable H

k5_unexplained_silent.definition: variable-H SILENT-LOADING cells, minus cells within 25 km of the SAF creeping segment, minus cells within 0.35 deg of any tsi_map.GEOTHERMAL field
